title: Facilitator in Microsoft Teams: what does the meeting agent do, and who can switch it off?
summary: Hold: the retention command is presented as configuring both notes and Teams chat interactions, but Microsoft documents a different cmdlet for the newer Teams chats location. The other controls, licensing requirements and described behaviour are supported; the retention navigation also needs a small clarification.

claims.claim: Facilitator can be allowed or blocked at Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > actions menu > Allow or Block.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -IsBlocked <boolean> modifies the app's tenant state.
claims.quote: This cmdlet allows administrators to modify app state, availability and installation status ... -Id: Application ID of Microsoft Teams app. ... -IsBlocked: The state of the app in the tenant. ... Type: Boolean

claims.claim: Facilitator availability is managed through Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Users and groups > Select to manage who this app is installed for or available to in your organization > Availability > Edit availability > Available to.
claims.quote: Select the Users and groups tab. ... Under Select to manage who this app is installed for or available to in your organization, select Availability. ... Select Edit availability. ... Select the required option from Available to menu.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -AppAssignmentType Everyone sets app availability to Everyone.
claims.quote: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone ... Updates the availability value for Bookings app ... to Everyone.

claims.claim: An admin UI for the tenant IsLoopEnabled control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin user interface tenant Teams Loop settings. Read microsoft-365/loop/loop-admin-configuration: Teams uses SharePoint PowerShell; the admin-center checkbox controls Loop workspaces, not IsLoopEnabled.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: An admin UI for the tenant IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin user interface tenant Teams Loop settings. Read loop-admin-configuration and facilitator-teams: this property uses SharePoint PowerShell; New Calendar's different Cloud Policy control is explicitly distinguished.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $false disables the documented meeting-notes control.
claims.quote: Disable Loop workspace creation and Loop component creation and integration everywhere ... [Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $false, Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $false

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is managed at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the selected meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The room's Take notes home-screen button is configured at Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: Automation for the room's Take notes home-screen button is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Show Take notes button home screen Facilitator PowerShell XML configuration API. Read facilitator-teams-rooms; searched rooms/xml-config-file for Take notes, Facilitator and note-taking (no matches). Search also states new Tap to take notes has no XML setting.

claims.claim: Static retention policies select Teams chats on Choose locations to apply the policy, or OneDrive accounts on Choose locations, after Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies. ... If you chose Static: On the Choose locations to apply the policy page ... If you chose Static: On the Choose locations page
claims.fix: Add Solutions before Data Lifecycle Management in controls[6].ui and the rendered path: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy (Teams chats) or Choose locations (OneDrive accounts). The two location-page labels are correct. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies.

claims.claim: New-RetentionComplianceRule -Policy <policy name> -RetentionDuration <days> -RetentionComplianceAction <Keep, Delete or KeepAndDelete> configures retention for both the Teams chats and OneDrive accounts locations shown in this row.
claims.quote: Don't use these cmdlets when the locations are for ... Teams chats (without Copilot interactions) ... These locations have alternative cmdlets that are identified in the next section.
claims.fix: Keep the existing call for OneDrive notes, but replace the row note with: 'Teams chats location for interactions, OneDrive accounts for notes; create separate policies for the two locations. Automation shown configures OneDrive accounts only, not the newer Teams chats location. The cmdlet adds a rule to an existing policy; duration is in days.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-cmdlets. Microsoft documents New-AppRetentionComplianceRule for the newer Teams chats location; do not present New-RetentionComplianceRule as its automation.

claims.claim: The Update-M365TeamsApp reference describes examples using both IsBlocked $true and $false as unblocking, so the page does not establish a reliable blocking value.
claims.quote: Example 3: ... -IsBlocked $true ... Unblocks Bookings app ... Example 4: ... -IsBlocked $false ... Unblocks 1Page App

claims.quote: Update-M365TeamsApp ... -AppAssignmentType UsersAndGroups -OperationType Add -Users ... -Groups ... updates availability setting for the app to include 2 users and 5 groups.
